notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1618842_hilma_hooker.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. On her starboard side on a sandy plateau at about 30 m off Bonaire, her port side at about 18 m: the hull whole, the bow to the south, the stern with its rudder and propeller to the north, the masts lying out over the sand, the bridge house aft. model_built.glb: the cargo ship as she was in 1984. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
